Right now every time I get a post whether it's an incoming message from the network or posted locally I (eventually during the process) re-fetch every post on the board it was posted on to regenerate every board, stupid yes, mostly caused by lazy design and most importantly the lack of foresight for "what If I get slashdotted" type scenarios.
